name: AA - Announcement Assistant
author: Nick Scilingo (FocusedOnSound)
description: Play pre-canned announcements over the currently playing show audio using PulseAudio mixing + automatic ducking. Includes 6 configurable slots, live trigger buttons, and FPP Command integration.

privacy.summary: Plays announcement audio you provide over the show, using FPP's own local playback/Command API. The optional Tune To matrix sign can fetch current weather from Open-Meteo (no account or API key) only when you enable that source; otherwise the plugin makes no outbound network calls, and it has no registration or license server.

sends.what: the latitude/longitude you enter for the Tune To weather display
sends.when: only when the Tune To weather source is set to Open-Meteo; polled on your configured interval (default every 10 minutes)
sends.why: to show current temperature, conditions, wind, and daily high/low on the matrix sign

collects.what: operational log: timestamp, action, file path, duck %, and the LAN IP that triggered the button

sensors.what: local temperature and humidity (plus barometric pressure on a BME280) from a DHT11/DHT22 or BME280 you wire to the Pi
sensors.when: only when the Tune To weather source is set to Local sensor
sensors.where: shown on the matrix sign; not stored or transmitted off the device

systemChanges.what: creates announcementassistant-pulse.service and rewrites /etc/pulse/system.pa and daemon.conf (originals backed up)
creates announcementassistant-tuneto.service (Tune To matrix-sign renderer; drives an FPP Pixel Overlay model via FPP's local overlay API)
installs python3-pil (Pillow) for the Tune To renderer; and, only if you select a Local sensor, the matching Adafruit CircuitPython library plus i2c-tools and adds the fpp user to the gpio/i2c groups
adds the pulse and fpp users to the audio group

privacy.other: FPP Command registrations ("Announcement Assistant - Play/Stop") let announcements be triggered from FPP's own schedules, playlists, and remote/API command paths, not just this plugin's own page - no new external listener is opened. The system PulseAudio socket (/run/pulse/native) allows anonymous, world-writable local connections by design, for FPP's own audio pipeline to reach it; it is not exposed over the network. Play-count resets are available in the UI; the operational log has no delete control.
